results.question: What is the primary purpose of the service request procedure?
results.reference: to change the 5GMM mode from 5GMM-IDLE to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.6.1.8, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: To allow a UE in CM-IDLE to establish a secure signalling connection to the AMF and request establishment of user-plane radio resources.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 24.501, clause 5.6.1 (Service request procedure — General): the service request procedure is used by a UE in CM-IDLE to establish a secure signalling connection and request user-plane radio resources.

results.question: Under what condition can a UE using control plane CIoT 5GS optimization initiate the service request procedure?
results.reference: for UE initiated transfer of user data via the control plane from 5GMM-IDLE mode
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.6.2.2.1, General
results.model_answer: A UE using control plane CIoT 5GS optimization can initiate the service request procedure only when it has uplink user data pending for transmission.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 24.501, clause 5.3.4.1 (Service request procedure initiation): requirement for a UE using control plane CIoT 5GS optimization to initiate service request only when uplink user data is pending.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Operator-defined access category definitions IE in 3GPP TS 24.501?
results.reference: to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE or delete the operator-defined access category definitions at the UE side
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.5.3, Operator-defined access categories
results.model_answer: It provides the UE with operator-defined access-category definitions, enabling the UE to determine the applicable access category for an access attempt and apply Unified Access Control (UAC) accordingly.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 24.501, clause 9.11, "Operator-defined access category definitions" IE (most likely the IE-specific subclause in the 5GMM information-elements section).
